description: Edit paths: open, close, reverse or join them, cut them with the scissors, add, move or delete anchor points, and convert points (Object > Paths, Object > Convert Point; Add, Delete and Convert Direction Point tools, Scissors tool)

action.description: open, close or reverse paths (Object > Paths; reversing a subpath of a compound path fills or empties its holes); set_point_type (Convert Point); add_point, move_point, delete_point (anchor point tools); cut (Scissors tool, at a point); join (Object > Paths > Join: close one open path, or join two open paths at their nearest end points). add_point, move_point, delete_point and cut act on one item

at.description: add_point with point: insert at this index (default at the end)

joinMode.description: join: connect the end points with a segment (default), or combine them into one point

path.description: Path index within the item (a compound path has several). open, close and reverse: default every path; others: default 0

point.description: add_point: a new anchor point with optional handles; move_point: new anchor (handles follow unless given), handles and type

left.description: Incoming direction handle [x, y] (mm); defaults to the anchor (no curve)

right.description: Outgoing direction handle [x, y] (mm); defaults to the anchor (no curve)

type.description: Point type: plain, corner, smooth or symmetrical

pointType.description: set_point_type: plain, corner, smooth or symmetrical

points.description: Point indexes: the points to convert (default all), to delete, to move (one) or to cut at (one)

segment.description: add_point: add a point on segment n (from point n to the next), keeping the path's shape

t.description: add_point with segment: where on the segment (0 to 1, default 0.5)

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_page_items, or the id a create tool returns), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: edit_path
title: Edit Path
